about_the_game:
Cafe New York 9/11 – A Story of Ordinary Lives in an Extraordinary Moment
Developed by the lead designer of Life is Strange: Double Exposure

In Cafe New York 9/11, you step into the shoes of Sameer, a hardworking Pakistani American café owner in Lower Manhattan. It’s a seemingly ordinary Tuesday morning. Your regulars filter in for their usual coffee and breakfast, conversations buzz about the Yankees game, work meetings, and weekend plans. But within moments, everything changes.

As the world outside shifts into chaos, your café becomes a temporary refuge. A place where frightened strangers, loyal customers, and your small team of employees come together, each reacting in their own way to the unthinkable events unfolding just blocks away.

Through Sameer’s eyes, you will navigate a deeply personal and emotional narrative, making choices that reveal the complexities of that event. Not just the shock and fear, but also the kindness, confusion, and resilience of the people around you.

Key Narrative Features

☕ A Personal Perspective on History – Experience the morning of 9/11 from the perspective of an immigrant café owner, balancing business, community, and survival.

💬 Interactive Storytelling – Engage in deeply emotional, branching dialogues where your responses shape relationships and reveal different sides of the people in your café.

🌆 A Living, Breathing New York – Witness the shift from a normal morning to crisis mode, as customers react, struggle to contact loved ones, and seek shelter.

🎭 A Diverse Cast of Characters – Meet New Yorkers from all walks of life—office workers, firefighters, tourists, and immigrants. Each with their own fears, biases, and humanity.

🔄 Choice-Driven Moments – Comfort a grieving customer, help someone with a problem at work or face the rising suspicion toward people like you. Every action shapes Sameer’s experience.

🎶 Atmospheric Sound & Music – From the hum of the café to the distant sirens outside, the soundscape features authentic Pakistani music. 

What do you do when the world stops?

Cafe New York 9/11 is not just about running a café. it’s about witnessing history through the eyes of someone caught between two worlds. It’s about community, identity, and the moments that define us in the face of crisis.

How will Sameer’s story unfold?

short_description: In Café New York, Step into the life of Sameer, a Pakistani American living in NYC during the week of 9/11. Sameer must navigate rising tensions, protect his family, and make impossible choices. Decisions that will shape his future and the fate of those around him in a city forever changed.
